text:
The pattern fits late 2024 best. The fed funds rate is high relative to its 3-year average (+1.0), but it has fallen over 3 months (-1.0), consistent with the Fed cutting in Sep–Dec 2024. The 10-year yield rose sharply over 3 months (+1.0), which matches the Oct–Dec 2024 backup in yields. Credit spreads are tight, VIX is low, and gold is strong. US equities fell over the last month, which suggests December 2024 (the Fed's hawkish cut), though the equity 6m and 12m returns are only moderately positive. Unemployment is up 1.0 over 12 months, which also fits late 2024.

Other months in the window are plausible, such as Nov or Dec 2024. Equities were up in November 2024 but down in December, so December is the better fit. Treasuries fell 1m, and gold rose 1m by +0.5, though gold was roughly flat to down in December. Still, December remains the best fit.

The core CPI z-score of -1.0 is also consistent with disinflation relative to the prior 3 years.
